faq.question: What do government & public sector organisations build on monday.com with Fruition?
faq.answer: This page shows 3 government & public sector use cases. The most common are work & project management (3), integrations & migration (2), operations & ERP (2), most often for projects & PMO, executive & strategy, operations & delivery teams.

faq.question: Which systems do government & public sector builds integrate with?
faq.answer: The integrations that come up most often in government & public sector use cases are Records management system, Outlook, Microsoft Teams, Zoho Desk.

useCases.title: Metropolitan local council strategy directorate
useCases.summary: A directorate of around 25 staff tracked BAU work and strategic projects in Teams and spreadsheets with no view of workload or priorities, while an ERP replacement was a year away.
useCases.challenge: A directorate of around 25 staff tracked BAU work and strategic projects in Teams and spreadsheets with no view of workload or priorities, while an ERP replacement was a year away.
boards: Portfolio dashboard: budget vs actual, progress, blocked/delayed items, portfolio Gantt
Project request form with approval workflow by value threshold
Auto-generated project templates on approval with dependencies
BAU task tracking alongside strategic projects
Resource capacity view against a 35-hour week incl. RDO/flex days
Links to records management system documents by URL
automations: Approved request → create project from template
Updates pushed to Teams channels and non-users
useCases.outcome: An interim work management platform giving directors portfolio, approval and capacity visibility, following a process and task mining workshop.

process.title: Project request approval to portfolio and capacity visibility

useCases.title: Metropolitan local council communications team
useCases.summary: The communications team had inconsistent use of an existing workspace, manual workflows with communication gaps, poor campaign progress tracking, document accessibility issues with the records system and permission limits that blocked collaboration with internal business partners.
useCases.challenge: The communications team had inconsistent use of an existing workspace, manual workflows with communication gaps, poor campaign progress tracking, document accessibility issues with the records system and permission limits that blocked collaboration with internal business partners.
boards: Live document collaboration with customised PDF export to the records system
Stakeholder access controls for business partners
Custom dashboards across boards with budget tracking
automations: Workflow automations with notifications and deadline alerts
useCases.outcome: A standardised intake-to-delivery campaign workflow with role-based stakeholder access, automated alerts and connected budget dashboards.

process.title: Campaign intake to delivery with stakeholder access controls

useCases.title: Regional local government authority
useCases.summary: New-starter onboarding was manual, leading to missed steps across 10-15 tasks, and IT tickets sat in a separate legacy help desk.
useCases.challenge: New-starter onboarding was manual, leading to missed steps across 10-15 tasks, and IT tickets sat in a separate legacy help desk.
boards: Employee onboarding workflow: HR/hiring-manager form with role dropdown
Role-based onboarding task sets (10-15 tasks: access keys, logins, building access, role-specific items)
IT service desk migrated from a legacy ticketing tool (~1,600 historical and ~30 active tickets with user history preserved)
automations: Onboarding form submitted → role-specific tasks created and stakeholders notified in parallel
Dependency (e.g. NDA signed) → admin access task unlocked

process.title: Role-based onboarding tasks for every new starter

steps.label: Logins and building access set up
IT requests handled in service desk
New starter ready on day one
